private_company_filing_gap: OpenAI Group PBC does not publish a public-company 10-K/10-Q set. The review therefore uses the latest public annual and quarterly reports of financially material counterparties SoftBank, Oracle and Blue Owl, plus issuer/developer/regulator originals.

pue.boundary: Abilene full-build data-center campus; design facility energy divided by IT-equipment energy
pue.period: Annualized design at full build; published 2026-05-28
pue.basis: Crusoe reports an annualized design PUE range of 1.2-1.4 for Abilene. The midpoint is used only as a modeling base. No measured operational PUE was disclosed, and the separate 2026 design requirement for new Crusoe projects is not substituted for Abilene.
pue.aggregation_rule: For future multi-site aggregation use sum(facility energy)/sum(IT energy), equivalently IT-energy-weighted site PUE; no cross-site aggregation is performed here.

model.revenue_scope: OpenAI/Stargate site-attributable recognized external compute revenue, or a clearly separated enforceable contracted rate; exclude financing, equity, RPO, customer prepayments, pass-through hardware and internal workloads
model.capacity_time_basis: Abilene full-build sensitivity only. The 1.2GW denominator is an exit/full-build facility design, not period-average active capacity. As of June 9, 2026 only the initial two 100MW buildings were confirmed operational and six remained under construction.

formulas.jevons: d/(1-d), only with a scoped realized price decline and matched paid task or token volume; currently unidentifiable

assumptions.basis: Midpoint of Crusoe's reported 1.2-1.4 annualized design range; not measured operational PUE.

structured_deals.economic_effect: $15B of JV funding supports a 1.2GW eight-building facility. It implies $12.5M per facility MW and, under the reported 1.2-1.4 design PUE, $15.0M-$17.5M per full-build IT MW. The perimeter is project/facility funding and must not be labeled compute-only capex.

OpenAI announced $110B of new investment; SoftBank says its final tranche brought cumulative investment to $64.6B and the bridge was repaid/cancelled. This funds the corporate balance sheet but is not site revenue or proof every infrastructure project is fully financed.

Oracle reported $288B of uncommenced leases, substantially all data-center leases with FY27Q2-FY29 starts and 15-19 year terms, plus $28.5B of Q1 capex and $11.4B of customer prepayments. These consolidated amounts cannot be allocated wholly to OpenAI/Stargate but demonstrate long-duration financing and delivery exposure.

The county authorized up to $165B of IRBs over 30 years, a tax-conduit ceiling rather than funded cash. NMED currently marks the microgrid air-permit process stayed by the New Mexico Supreme Court. FT separately reported roughly $18B of loans indicated at 89-91 cents and a force-majeure notice; those market details remain secondary and do not establish cancellation or default.

findings: OpenAI says Stargate has surpassed 10GW of secured/committed capacity, but that is not active or billable MW. At Abilene, only the first two 100MW buildings were confirmed operational as of June 9, 2026; six remained under construction.

Abilene provides a primary-backed facility-capital benchmark: $15B / 1.2GW equals $12.5M per facility MW. The reported 1.2-1.4 design PUE implies 857-1,000 full-build IT MW and $15.0M-$17.5M of project capital per IT MW.

At explicit 70%-90% utilization sensitivities, Abilene project capital is $16.7M-$25.0M per effective utilized IT MW, with $20.3M at 1.3 PUE and 80% utilization. This is a capital intensity, not revenue productivity.

The canonical revenue-per-effective-MW output remains blank because OpenAI does not disclose matched site revenue, period-average active IT capacity, external/internal allocation or measured physical utilization.

Project Jupiter combines genuine development evidence with execution risk: the public air-permit notice is stayed, while secondary reporting places an approximately $18B loan package near 89-91 cents. Neither fact proves project cancellation or borrower default.
